title: 'Time traveller' from 6,000 claims to have a photo - and bad news for humanity
excerpt: A man who claims to have travelled to the year 6000 has shared a video of himself meeting with a journalist to discuss the future of humanity and the alleged 'secret technologies' that will be developed
content:
A man who claims to have travelled to the year 6000 has shared a video of himself meeting with a journalist to discuss the future of humanity and the alleged 'secret technologies' that will be developed

09:30, 13 Sep 2026

Step aside Doctor Who – this man reckons he's journeyed to the future and has photographic proof to support his claim.

‌

The bizarre footage showcases the alleged 'time traveller', his identity hidden, meeting with a journalist at an undisclosed location to spill the beans on 'secret technologies' and the destiny of humankind in the year 6000.

‌

The self-styled whistleblower, speaking through voice distortion, claims he was involved in a covert operation that propelled people into the future during the 1990s.

‌

Mysterious rules for everlasting love, wild weather ahead, the Moon was created in just five hours, old mice get their groove back, and ‘devil flower’ found - all this and more in our weird science newsletter

He maintains that advancements in healthcare, governance, and state-of-the-art technology will make our current way of life seem 'primitive', with humanity living peacefully under the benevolent rule of an artificial intelligence sovereign.

As supposed evidence, halfway through his rambling interview, he produces a photograph of an unidentifiable cityscape.

‌

Unfortunately, it's so blurred it looks more like a Monet painting than a futuristic metropolis.

But hold on – he clarifies: "In the time travel process pictures tend to get distorted, as well as many other things. I know a lot of you are going to find my story extremely hard to believe and I don't blame you and if I was watching somebody claim these same things I myself would most likely not believe them.

‌

"It is not my intention to deceive anybody, I simply want to spread a message about the future of humanity and where the world is heading. In the time travel process pictures tend to get distorted, as well as many other things.

"I have seen the way the world's changed and the technologies that have emerged it would blow your mind if you only knew the technologies that exist in the year 6000."

‌

In a bizarre twist, the alleged 'time traveller' becomes emotional as he reveals he left behind a beloved friend who cannot make the return journey.

He explained: "I know he's in a good place. In a way the future is like a utopia but sadly when we attempted to travel back we couldn't. I just wanted to see him one more time."

In what seems to reference the movie Downsizing, he maintains that future innovations will allow humans to shrink in size, solving any worries about overpopulation.

Article continues below

Whether you buy into his claims or not, there's not long to wait - he maintains time travel will become public knowledge by 2028.

The clip was uploaded to ApexTV, a platform dedicated to mysterious occurrences and paranormal activity. It has already racked up more than 3 million views.
